conclusion: InlongSlicer application-version checks remain disabled. PresetUpdater::version_check_enabled() is false; GUI_App::check_new_version_sf returns before HTTP, and normal/forced update-event handlers suppress release dialogs. The Help and command-palette update actions and stable-only preference remain removed. Profile and plugin synchronization retains its independent behavior. Upstream d16ca97380 changes MainFrame shortcut/focus handling only. All other update-policy snapshots are unchanged. This merge rebuilt native GUI static code and regressions while preserving installed EXE/DLL and all 832 current user settings files; it is not a new installation or interactive update-dialog observation.
